title: fix(plugin-detail): a related-list toolbar action authored `visible: false` is hidden (objectui#11244)
body:
Fixes #11244

Clause-②: no

## What this does

`RelatedToolbarButton` (the `list_toolbar` header button of a related list, in `packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`) decided whether an action declared a `visible` gate by truthiness: `if (visiblePred && !isVisible) return null;`. A literal `visible: false` is falsy, so the gate was skipped and the button rendered for everyone.

It now asks the question with the existing `hasDeclaredVisibilityGate`, imported from `@object-ui/components` like the rest of the action family (objectui#3812): `if (hasDeclaredVisibilityGate(visiblePred) && !isVisible) return null;`. No second gate helper was added. The `useCondition(..., { throwOnError: true })` evaluation from PR objectui#11237 is unchanged, so a predicate that faults still hides the button and is reported once.

`@object-ui/plugin-detail` already imported from `@object-ui/components` (a peer and dev dependency), so no manifest changed. `RelatedRecordActionsBridge`'s `deriveActions` and the `record:related_list` renderer (PR objectui#11263) are not touched. The authored actions of that renderer render through this same button, so the fix reaches them.

| authored `visible` | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `false` | shown | **hidden** |
| `true` / absent | shown | shown |
| `''` | shown (no gate) | shown (no gate) |
| `'   '` (whitespace only) | hidden | **shown** (no gate) |
| CEL that answers true / false | shown / hidden | shown / hidden |
| CEL that faults | hidden, reported once | hidden, reported once |

The whitespace row moves too. The helper reads a blank predicate as no gate (objectui#3960), as every other action surface already does, so a whitespace-only `visible` no longer hides the button from everyone. The changeset says so.

## Pins

A new `describe` block for objectui#11244 sits in `related-toolbar-visible.test.tsx`, next to the objectui#11212 `visible` pins. It covers `visible: false` hides (the DETECTOR), `visible: true` shows, a blank `visible` (`''` and whitespace) shows, and a CEL string that answers true shows while one that answers false hides. The fault leg stays pinned by the existing objectui#11212 block in the same file ("hides a toolbar action whose predicate faults, and reports it once, naming the action"). It is also pinned by the related-list toolbar block in app-shell's `currentUserCan-failClosed-11212.render.test.tsx`. Both are green on this branch.

The failures were "hides a toolbar action authored `visible: false` (DETECTOR)" (`expected BUTTON to be null`) and the whitespace row.

The anchor `if (hasDeclaredVisibilityGate(visiblePred) && !isVisible) return null;` was replaced by the truthiness spelling (anchor x1 to x0, blob `66ad00d94746` to `39e8edddf778`). The run gave `Tests  2 failed | 10 passed (12)`, the same two tests. The restore was proven: blob after restore == blob at HEAD (`66ad00d94746`), and `git diff HEAD` was empty. ## Acceptance notes

These came from the sweep of `packages/plugin-detail/src` that the dispatch asked for. None of them is changed here.

- **No other truthiness gate in the package.** I grepped the package's non-test source for a `visible` / `disabled` / `enabled` / `hidden` value or verdict joined by `&&`. At this branch it finds only the gate fixed here. At the base commit `f4ed2387e9` it finds the old `if (visiblePred && !isVisible)`, which is the control. The header built-ins in `DetailView.tsx` read `userActions.*.visibleWhen ?? true` and `disabledWhen != null && …`. Those are null checks, not truthiness, so `visibleWhen: false` hides there.
- **A `detail-view` tab's string `visible` is never evaluated.** This is a different class, not truthiness. `DetailTabs` returns `true` for any string `visible`, with the comment "Simple expression evaluation could go here". I measured it once with a throwaway jsdom probe through the real `DetailView` (not committed): a tab with `visible: '1 == 2'` rendered, and a tab with `visible: false` was hidden. objectui's own `DetailViewTabSchema.visible` admits a string and describes it as "Tab visibility condition". I found no named producer and did not measure it through a public door. The two in-repo producers of a `detail-view` node emit no `tabs`. Noted here for the seat. Nobody carries it.
- **The `list_item` row path asks "declared?" with its own check.** It uses components' `isCustomRowActionVisible` and plugin-grid's twin, which test `pred == null || pred === ''`. That is not truthiness, so `visible: false` hides a row action. But it is a second definition next to `hasDeclaredPredicate`, whose header says nothing else in the repo asks the question. On a whitespace-only `visible` the two can disagree. I read this and did not measure it. Nobody carries it.
